legend: For each given integer $N$: write $N$ in binary, count its ones $K$, and print the number whose binary form is $K$ ones (that is, $2^K - 1$).
input: The first line contains $T$ ($1 \le T \le 10$), the number of test cases. Each of the next $T$ lines contains an integer $N$ ($1 \le N \le 2^{31} - 1$).
output: For each test case print the answer on its own line.
notes: $10$ is $1010$ in binary. It has $2$ ones, and $11$ in binary is $3$.
